# Game Idea: **Astro Dash**

A top‑down endless‑runner on an HTML canvas where you control a tiny spacecraft 
that constantly accelerates forward through a scrolling asteroid field. 
Use the mouse or arrow keys to steer left/right and a boost button for short 
speed bursts. Collect glowing energy orbs to extend your fuel and gain 
temporary shields.

**Lose condition**: The game ends when the ship collides with an asteroid 
or runs out of fuel.

The simple graphics (circles for asteroids, a triangle for the ship) and 
basic physics make it quick to prototype, while the lose condition adds a 
clear challenge and encourages replayability.

1: // Astro Dash – enhanced graphics version
2: (() => {
3:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
4:   if (!canvas) return; // safety if not present
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   const width = (canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800);
7:   const height = (canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600);
8: 
9:   // ------- Audio setup -------
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   const playTone = (freq, duration) => {
12:     const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     oscillator.type = 'sine';
15:     oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
17:     oscillator.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     oscillator.start();
19:     oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
20:   };
21:   const playBoost = () => playTone(300, 0.08);
22:   const playCollect = () => playTone(600, 0.12);
23:   const playExplosion = () => playTone(150, 0.4);
24: 
25: 
26:   // ------- Game state -------
27:   const ship = {
28:     x: width / 2,
29:     y: height * 0.85,
30:     radius: 12,
31:     speed: 2, // base forward speed (asteroid scroll speed)
32:     fuel: 100,
33:     shield: 0, // frames remaining
34:   };
35:   const keys = { left: false, right: false, boost: false };
36:   const asteroids = [];
37:   const orbs = [];
38:   const stars = [];
39:   let frame = 0;
40:   let gameOver = false;
41: 
42:   // ------- Input handling -------
43:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
44:     resumeAudio();
45:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = true;
46:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = true;
47:     if (e.key === ' ') keys.boost = true;
48:   });
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
50:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') keys.left = false;
51:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys.right = false;
52:     if (e.key === ' ') keys.boost = false;
53:   });
54:   // mouse steering (optional)
55:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
56:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
57:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
58:   });
59: 
60:   // ------- Helpers -------
61:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
62:   const circleCollide = (a, b) => {
63:     const dx = a.x - b.x;
64:     const dy = a.y - b.y;
65:     const r = a.radius + b.radius;
66:     return dx * dx + dy * dy < r * r;
67:   };
68: 
69:   // ------- Spawn logic -------
70:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
71:     const size = rand(10, 30);
72:     asteroids.push({ x: rand(size, width - size), y: -size, radius: size, speed: ship.speed + rand(0.5, 1.5) });
73:   };
74:   const spawnOrb = () => {
75:     const rad = 8;
76:     orbs.push({ x: rand(rad, width - rad), y: -rad, radius: rad, speed: ship.speed });
77:   };
78:   // stars: tiny background points
79:   const spawnStar = () => {
80:     const size = rand(0.5, 1.5);
81:     const speed = ship.speed * 0.5 + rand(0.1, 0.3);
82:     stars.push({ x: rand(0, width), y: -size, radius: size, speed });
83:   };
84: 
85:   // ------- Game loop -------
86:   const update = () => {
87:     if (gameOver) return;
88:     frame++;
89: 
90:     // increase difficulty over time
91:     if (frame % 80 === 0) spawnAsteroid();
92:     if (frame % 300 === 0) spawnOrb();
93:     // background stars
94:     if (frame % 5 === 0) spawnStar();
95: 
96:     // ship movement
97:     const moveX = (keys.left ? -1 : 0) + (keys.right ? 1 : 0);
98:     ship.x += moveX * 4;
99:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.radius, Math.min(width - ship.radius, ship.x));
100:     // boost speed consumes fuel
101:     const boostFactor = keys.boost && ship.fuel > 0 ? 2 : 1;
102:     const currentSpeed = ship.speed * boostFactor;
103:     if (keys.boost && ship.fuel > 0) {
104:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.3);
105:       playBoost();
106:     }
107:     // fuel drain over time
108:     ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 0.02);
109:     // shield timer decay
110:     if (ship.shield > 0) ship.shield--;
111: 
112:     // move obstacles/orbs downwards
113:     const moveObjs = arr => {
114:       for (let i = arr.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:         const o = arr[i];
116:         o.y += o.speed * boostFactor;
117:         if (o.y - o.radius > height) arr.splice(i, 1);
118:       }
119:     };
120:     moveObjs(asteroids);
121:     moveObjs(orbs);
122:     moveObjs(stars);
123: 
124:     // collision detection
125:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
126:       const a = asteroids[i];
127:         if (circleCollide(ship, a)) {
128:           if (ship.shield > 0) {
129:             ship.shield = 0;
130:             asteroids.splice(i, 1);
131:           } else {
132:             gameOver = true;
133:             playExplosion();
134:           }
135:         }
136:     }
137:     for (let i = orbs.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
138:       const o = orbs[i];
139:         if (circleCollide(ship, o)) {
140:           ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 20);
141:           ship.shield = 180; // 3 seconds shield
142:           orbs.splice(i, 1);
143:           playCollect();
144:         }
145:     }
146:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
147: 
148:     draw();
149:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(update);
150:     else drawGameOver();
151:   };
152: 
153:   // ------- Rendering -------
154:   const draw = () => {
155:     // Background: dark space gradient
156:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
157:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
158:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
159:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
160:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
161: 
162:     // Stars – tiny white points
163:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
164:     stars.forEach(s => {
165:       ctx.beginPath();
166:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
167:       ctx.fill();
168:     });
169: 
170:     // Ship – triangle with optional flame for boost
171:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.shield > 0 ? 'gold' : 'white';
172:     ctx.beginPath();
173:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y - ship.radius);
174:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
175:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius, ship.y + ship.radius);
176:     ctx.closePath();
177:     ctx.fill();
178:     if (keys.boost && ship.fuel > 0) {
179:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
180:       ctx.beginPath();
181:       ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.radius);
182:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x - ship.radius / 2, ship.y + ship.radius + 8);
183:       ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.radius / 2, ship.y + ship.radius + 8);
184:       ctx.closePath();
185:       ctx.fill();
186:     }
187: 
188:     // Asteroids – gray circles with subtle stroke
189:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
190:       ctx.beginPath();
191:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
192:       ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
193:       ctx.fill();
194:       ctx.strokeStyle = '#333';
195:       ctx.lineWidth = 1;
196:       ctx.stroke();
197:     });
198: 
199:     // Energy orbs – cyan with radial glow
200:     orbs.forEach(o => {
201:       const orbGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.radius);
202:       orbGrad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
203:       orbGrad.addColorStop(1, '#004');
204:       ctx.fillStyle = orbGrad;
205:       ctx.beginPath();
206:       ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
207:       ctx.fill();
208:     });
209: 
210:     // HUD – fuel bar on top left with border
211:     ctx.fillStyle = 'lime';
212:     const barWidth = 100;
213:     ctx.fillRect(10, 10, (ship.fuel / 100) * barWidth, 8);
214:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'white';
215:     ctx.lineWidth = 1;
216:     ctx.strokeRect(10, 10, barWidth, 8);
217:   };
218: 
219:   const drawGameOver = () => {
220:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
221:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
222:     ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
223:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
224:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
225:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
226:   };
227: 
228:   // start loop
229:   update();
230: })();

(End of file - total 230 lines)
</content>
